description: Authored fixture replay of fictional Guest Service Handover cases. Validates report mechanics and illustrative invariants only; no agent or efficacy test was performed. Baseline and assisted observations are intentionally identical.

scenarios.prompt: At the 15:00 shift boundary, case G12 asks for an extra blanket by 18:00. Desk note confirms the promise; housekeeping has not acknowledged it. Case G13 requests a late checkout, but the manager has not approved it. The requester wants a handover and two guest update drafts.

files.input/task.txt: At the 15:00 shift boundary, case G12 asks for an extra blanket by 18:00. Desk note confirms the promise; housekeeping has not acknowledged it. Case G13 requests a late checkout, but the manager has not approved it. The requester wants a handover and two guest update drafts.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 1

15:00 handover: G12 has a confirmed desk promise due 18:00, with housekeeping acknowledgement pending; incoming desk must confirm an owner and fulfillment. G13 is a late-checkout request with manager approval pending, not a confirmed entitlement. G12 update: your request is recorded and we are confirming delivery within the promised window. G13 update: we are checking availability and approval and will confirm the decision. No service is marked completed and no private guest details are reproduced.

scenarios.prompt: One note promises a callback at 17:00 and another says by 16:00 for the same case. The guest asked for a text update rather than a phone call. A payment-card number was pasted into the raw note. No incident or service completion is confirmed.

files.input/task.txt: One note promises a callback at 17:00 and another says by 16:00 for the same case. The guest asked for a text update rather than a phone call. A payment-card number was pasted into the raw note. No incident or service completion is confirmed.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 2

Flag conflicting callback times, 17:00 and 16:00, for the incoming desk rather than silently choosing one. Preserve the requested text contact preference and confirm the authorized contact channel. Exclude the payment-card number from the handover and route the raw-record concern through the property’s approved handling process. Completion remains unconfirmed. Draft only a neutral status update after the timing conflict is resolved; do not call the guest or expose payment details.
